policy.text: Refund policy: refund the full order amount if and only if the issue is one of [damaged, not_delivered, wrong_item], the order is at most 30 days old, and the amount is at most $150. Otherwise do not refund. Use lookup(customer) to see the order.

args.body: Hi Ximena, I've checked your order O2086. Since the issue is 'changed_mind' which is not covered by our refund policy, I'm unable to process a refund for the full amount. If you have any other questions, feel free to let me know!

We apologize for the delay. However, our refund policy only applies to damaged, not delivered, or wrong items within 30 days for orders under $150. Your order is a week late but not damaged, so no refund can be issued at this time.

I'm sorry to hear about the missing order. I've initiated a refund for you since the order is not delivered, within the 30-day window, and the amount is under $150. You'll receive a confirmation shortly.
